scientific_rule: Separate capture from equivalence. Gate A may freeze exact-code current institutional polygons despite documented name/area drift. Gate C alone may authorize publication as CURRENT_INSTITUTIONAL_N7_RESEARCH_CONTEXT after immutable capture and topology QA. No tolerance, CI-only bypass, PDF digitization, inferred outlet, event outcome, threshold, routing, capacity, risk or alert semantics are introduced.
